analysis_prepared: Reuse existing bundle/source verification, cache export and official saved-count paired read. The unsigned root READ is confirmed to refuse before opening task sources. Each mode retains its own A/A; no pooling of repeat runs into extra independent sample support.
decision: Keep independent role text optimization available with the existing trajectory scheduler. The separate fixed-policy slot-affinity experiment tests cache retention and cost; it is not a prerequisite for changing role text. Await every admitted member and exact root READ before any cache or quality interpretation.
interpretation_scope: The fixed-policy panel changes slot routing while preserving speech-query-prefix-v2. Query speech precedes the contact-instruction history suffix. It does not test relocating invariant node instructions ahead of the variable query, and cannot settle all possible node-specific prefix layouts. A future layout change would be a separate prospective request-semantics factor with its own capacity, structural and complete-family checks.
